title: Explicit marked internal Hom and exponential adjunction
statement: Use the simplicial sets, standard simplices and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and [def-weil-size-convention]. A marked simplicial set is a pair $(X,M_X)$ with $M_X\subseteq X_1$ containing all degenerate edges; morphisms preserve marked edges. Products mark precisely pairs of marked edges. Write $K^\flat$ for a simplicial set with only its degenerate edges marked and $K^\sharp$ for one with every edge marked. For any marked simplicial sets $X,Y$, define a simplicial set $H(X,Y)$ by $H(X,Y)_n=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}^+}(X\times(\Delta^n)^\flat,Y)$, with operators given by restriction in the simplex parameter. Declare an edge marked exactly when the corresponding map $X\times(\Delta^1)^\flat\to Y$ preserves also the markings of $X\times(\Delta^1)^\sharp$. These formulas define a marked simplicial set, functorial contravariantly in $X$ and covariantly in $Y$. Evaluation induces natural bijections $$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}^+}(Z,H(X,Y))\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}^+}(Z\times X,Y)$$ for every marked simplicial set $Z$. The bijection is the ordinary simplicial transpose restricted to marking-preserving maps: a transpose preserves markings if and only if evaluation sends every pair of marked edges of $Z$ and $X$ to a marked edge of $Y$. Thus $H(X,Y)$ is the marked internal Hom $Y^X$. The construction and bijection stay in the universe of $X,Y,Z$.
